email.subject1: a signal play for Gorilla Logic
email.body1:
Bob, saw Gorilla Logic stood up an advisory board and partnered with Graphio.ai to tighten GTM execution across your delivery hubs.

Moves like that usually mean more in-market accounts than the team can personally cover before the new GTM plays land. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Gorilla Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bob, quick follow-up for Gorilla Logic.

As CGO, you're carrying the growth number, but coverage rarely scales as fast as the targets do. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit them, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Gorilla Logic needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bob, last bit of proof for Gorilla Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Gorilla Logic's reply rate likely compares to other software services teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bob, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing is everything while you're tightening GTM execution, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Gorilla Logic either way.
